title: 3:4竖版，带一点叛逆感的室内时尚抓拍。一名明确成年的女性坐在深灰色沙发上，位于
prompt:
3:4竖版，带一点叛逆感的室内时尚抓拍。一名明确成年的女性坐在深灰色沙发上，位于画面右侧。她有长而柔软的浅铜棕色卷发，精致但自然的眼妆，表情冷静，直视镜头。她穿一件白色露肩礼服，胸前有银色亮片与刺绣装饰，裙摆是蓬松的白色薄纱；服装保持完整遮挡。

人物的一条腿朝镜头伸出，穿白色袜子的脚靠近镜头，占据画面左侧大部分前景，并因浅景深而明显虚化，形成夸张的近大远小透视。另一条腿自然弯曲。她在身前抬起一只手，清楚地做出竖中指手势。人物面部相对清晰，姿态随意而大胆。

背景是带褶皱的灰紫色窗帘和深灰色沙发。整体采用柔和的室内光与轻微直闪观感，颜色以象牙白、淡紫、灰色和暖铜棕为主。画面略微柔焦，带少量颗粒和低分辨率照片的质感，像一张不经精修的时尚后台照片。低机位、近距离、广角透视，前景强烈虚化，人物脸部是第二视觉焦点。真实摄影，不要插画或CG效果。无文字、无水印。

Vertical 3:4 indoor fashion snapshot with a slightly rebellious mood. A clearly adult woman sits on a dark gray sofa, positioned toward the right side of the frame. She has long, softly waved light copper-brown hair, refined but natural eye makeup, and a calm expression as she looks directly at the camera. She wears an off-the-shoulder white dress with silver sequin and embroidered details across the bodice and a voluminous white tulle skirt. Keep the outfit fully covering her.

One leg extends toward the camera. Her white-socked foot is very close to the lens, filling much of the left foreground and becoming noticeably out of focus, creating exaggerated foreshortening. Her other leg bends naturally. She raises one hand in front of her and clearly makes a middle-finger gesture. Keep her face relatively sharp, with a casual, bold pose.

Behind her are pleated gray-lavender curtains and the dark gray sofa. Use soft indoor light with a subtle direct-flash snapshot feel. The palette is ivory white, muted lavender, gray, and warm copper-brown. Slight softness, fine grain, and the texture of a low-resolution, minimally retouched backstage fashion photo. Low camera position, close distance, wide-angle perspective, strong foreground blur, with her face as the secondary focal point. Photorealistic; no illustration, CGI, text, or watermark.
